_comment: Mesh repo-templating token classifier (Phase 1 pilot). Consumed by render-handlebars.js and referenced by scripts/secret-scan.sh. sed remains the DEFAULT renderer; this governs the opt-in Handlebars path and future repo emission.

allowlist._comment: Git-safe brand-delta tokens that MAY be substituted into an emitted repo. These are tenant-brand identity, never secrets. 4 are live in templates/apps today; 3 are registered-but-currently-dead; HOST_NAME/GENERATOR_ORG_GROUP/NPM_SCOPE are the Phase-2 login-ui overlay tokens (templates/repos/login-ui) — all ORG/BRAND-derived, none secret-bearing.

denylist._comment: Secret-bearing keys derived from brands/example.conf + brand.conf.example. Rendering/emit MUST refuse to substitute or emit any of these. Exact keys plus a catch-all regex over key NAMES.

frozen_protocol_constants._comment: OUT-OF-SCOPE-FOR-TOKENIZATION. These are wire/label protocol identity, NOT tenant brand. They must stay literal in every emitted repo and must NEVER be turned into {{tokens}} nor rewritten by any renderer. A blind reverse-substitution that rebrands the literal 'snapdragon' would corrupt these.
